name: fred_retail_sales
description:
The US advance retail and food services sales from FRED, the St. Louis Fed's economic database: series RSAFS (millions of dollars, monthly).
Returns {"series": "RSAFS", "data": <FRED observations response>}; data.observations = [{date (YYYY-MM-DD), value (a string, "." if missing), realtime_start, realtime_end}], newest first; data is {"error": ...} if the call fails.
Inputs (* required): limit (integer, number of newest observations; default 30).
Related: fred_pce, fred_consumer_sentiment, fred_auto_sales.
Example: {"limit": 12}

limit.description: Number of most recent observations to return (newest first)

data.description: FRED's series/observations response; {"error": ...} when the call fails

value.description: The observation's value as text ("." when FRED has none)
